cards.Description: The UPS died right in the middle of ____.
cards.note: New card (debate): Challenger amendment: open-ended blank instead of a self-answering 'because'.

cards.Description: This month's bijli bill charged me extra for ____.
cards.note: New card (debate): Challenger amendment: 'bijli bill' is accurate nationwide; WAPDA no longer issues household bills.

cards.Description: The neighbour's generator always starts right when ____.
cards.note: New card (debate): New relatable load-shedding card; no generator card exists.

cards.Description: The external examiner's only question in my viva was ____.
cards.note: New card (debate): New university card; no viva card exists.

cards.Description: The mohalla doctor gives an injection for everything, even ____.
cards.note: New card (debate): Classic desi clinic joke; no injection card exists.

cards.Description: My sibling and I fought over the AC remote until ____.
cards.note: New card (debate): Relatable sibling fight; distinct from the TV remote card.

cards.Description: The aunty asked my salary and then immediately ____.
cards.note: New card (debate): Reaction joke, not another aunty-question duplicate.

cards.Description: Every drama villain is finally defeated by ____.
cards.note: New card (debate): Accurate drama trope; no villain-defeat card exists.

cards.Description: The Daewoo hostess's announcement before departure included ____.
cards.note: New card (debate): Local bus-travel joke, distinct from existing Daewoo smell/seat cards.

cards.Description: Nani's foolproof cure for nazar: burn some red chillies and ____.
cards.note: New card (debate): Burning red chillies against nazar is a real, well-known desi practice. The deck has only one other nazar prompt.

cards.Description: Ammi says the jinn living in the old peepal tree outside really hates ____.
cards.note: New card (debate): A common superstition, and a different joke from the existing jinn cards.

cards.Description: Never walk past the qabristan at night, especially if you're carrying ____.
cards.note: New card (debate): A familiar, mildly spooky superstition. It does not mock the dead and has no duplicate.

cards.Description: I always say "bas paanch minute mein pohanch raha hoon" when I'm actually ____.
cards.note: New card (debate): Very relatable desi toxic trait in natural Roman Urdu. Not a duplicate.

cards.Description: I keep a secret list of every relative who ever ____.
cards.note: New card (debate): A different, family-based setup from 'I hold grudges over ____'.

cards.Description: I took career advice from the rishta aunty, and now I'm ____.
cards.note: New card (debate): Clean, and different from the other cards.

cards.Description: Breaking news: the PCB has replaced the entire cricket team with ____.
cards.note: New card (debate): A different joke from the PCB 'has banned ____' card. Cricket fits the deck.

cards.Description: Our gali cricket match was called off because of ____.
cards.note: New card (debate): New local prompt. The full deck has no street-cricket card.

cards.Description: Introducing Ludo 2.0: same rules as before, but now with ____.
cards.note: New card (debate): New local prompt. The only Ludo card is a betting prompt with a different idea.

cards.Description: The sign at Chacha's kiryana store says: "Udhaar is closed. ____ is open."
cards.note: New card (debate): Plays on the familiar shop sign about credit. The deck has no udhaar card.

cards.Description: Abbu refuses to hand over the TV remote unless someone brings him ____.
cards.note: New card (debate): Clean family prompt. The only remote card ('I threw my TV remote') has a different idea.

cards.Description: The mohalla chowkidar blew his whistle all night because of ____.
cards.note: New card (debate): Clean local neighbourhood prompt. A search of the deck found no chowkidar card.

cards.Description: My patang got tangled in ____, and now the whole mohalla is involved.
cards.note: New card (debate): Clean kite-flying prompt. The deck has no kite or patang card.
